It composes linear and rotary joints, marks generated bodies, notes missing figures, and refuses invalid input by name. The held patch is uncommitted in /home/mikekinney/CamcraftCodex/.claude/worktrees/issue-2584 on issue/2584-machine-model, based on upstream/main e5b0ca3c1. Nothing was pushed and no PR was opened.

cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main passed twice. cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings failed first on collapsible_if in build.rs; that is fixed. The second run failed on six err_expect warnings in crates/sim/tests/machine_model/refusals.rs at lines 68, 108, 145, 152, 172, and 215. Those test chains need expect_err() instead of err().expect(). I stopped under the two-failure rule before changing them. Step 8 and Step 9 were not reached.

Local evidence is outside the branch at /tmp/2584-before.log, /tmp/2584-mutation-summary.txt, /tmp/2584-gate.log, and /tmp/2584-clippy.log. The issue is free again.
